### Notes

Could not inspect: the credit/usage amount, the program duration, and any eligibility thresholds (funding, age, employees) — none are published on the program page or its FAQ. The FAQ answers only fit, not eligibility: "Snowflake is a great fit for your startup if you're working with data." The application route is described only as "We encourage all interested startups to reach out through our contact form"; no form URL is exposed in the rendered markup, so apply_url points at the program page itself. The separate Snowflake Startup Challenge (up to $1 million in investments) is a competition, not this program, and is not reflected in this record. Quote re-confirmed verbatim under the Startup Package section 2026-09-16. No credit amount, duration or eligibility threshold is published; the page directs startups to a contact form.
